title: Draft: wslua: Keep support for Lua 5.1 and 5.2 on 32bit
description:
Add wslua_pushinteger macro to use lua_pushnumber for Lua 5.1/5.2
and lua_pushinteger for Lua 5.3/5.4.

Ping #10881

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15327/diffs?diff_id=987972242&start_sha=56b43c0efed20bcdbd263ce8b257b59b29832550)
changed title from **Draft: wslua: {-Use lua_pushnumber for Lua < 5.3-}** to **Draft: wslua: {+Keep support for Lua 5.1 and 5.2 on 32bit+}**

@stigbjorlykke Thank you for the patch. I've tested in on armhf changing cmake's Lua detection to pick up 5.2, too, but the build still failed at other places.

Since master does not support Lua 5.2 anymore I think this change should not be applied to master, just to release-4.2 to keep 4.2.x working with Lua 5.2 on 32 systems.
Also I'd like to handle casts, too, with a separate macro. Let me file an MR against release-4.2
